name: DataClassification
description:
Manage data classification for Unity Catalog catalogs.
Data classification automatically identifies and tags sensitive data (PII) in Unity Catalog tables.
Each catalog can have at most one configuration resource that controls scanning behavior and auto-tagging rules.

methods.name: CreateCatalogConfig
methods.description:
Create Data Classification configuration for a catalog.

Creates a new config resource, which enables Data Classification
for the specified catalog.
- The config must not already exist for the catalog.

required_fields.name: parent
required_fields.description: Parent resource in the format: catalogs/{catalog_name}

required_in_url_fields.description: Parent resource in the format: catalogs/{catalog_name}

all_fields.name: parent
all_fields.description: Parent resource in the format: catalogs/{catalog_name}

all_fields.name: auto_tag_configs
all_fields.description:
List of auto-tagging configurations for this catalog.
Empty list means no auto-tagging is enabled.

all_fields.name: excluded_schemas
all_fields.description:
Schemas to exclude from the scan, each named relative to the parent catalog.
If specified, all schemas except the specified ones will be scanned.
Mutually exclusive with `included_schemas`: only one may be set per request.
If neither `included_schemas` nor `excluded_schemas` is set, all schemas are scanned.

all_fields.name: included_schemas
all_fields.description:
Schemas to include in the scan, each named relative to the parent catalog.
If specified, only listed schemas will be scanned.
Mutually exclusive with `excluded_schemas`: only one may be set per request.
If neither `included_schemas` nor `excluded_schemas` is set, all schemas are scanned.

methods.name: UpdateCatalogConfig
methods.description:
Update the Data Classification configuration for a catalog.
- The config must already exist for the catalog.
- Updates fields specified in the update_mask.  Use update_mask field to perform partial updates of the configuration.
